## Hypothesis

We hypothesized that adjusting the shotgun scalper parameters (tp_premium_pct, stop_premium_pct, time_stop_min, strike_offset, chandelier_arm_pct, vol_ratio_threshold) would improve edge capture on J's anchor days by optimizing entry timing and exit management. However, the result shows negative edge capture, indicating the hypothesis is not supported.

## Mechanism

Enter when volume ratio exceeds 1.2 (vol_ratio_threshold) using OTM-2 put strikes (strike_offset=2). Exit at 50% premium gain (tp_premium_pct=0.5), 30% premium loss (stop_premium_pct=-0.3), or 10-minute time stop (time_stop_min=10). Chandelier profit-lock arms at 50% favor (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5) and trails 15% off the high-water mark.
